title: Implement an Inorder Iterator for a Binary Search Tree
problemStatement: Design an iterator for a Binary Search Tree that supports retrieving the next smallest element in amortized O(1) time using O(h) auxiliary space, where h is the height of the tree.
input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the BST. • The following line contains Q operations. • Each operation is either NEXT or HASNEXT.
output: • For each operation, print the corresponding result.
